app TypedContextScopes
Given
 Trace { who:text, scope:text, zone:timezone, origin:text, invocation:text, instant:datetime }
 policy Trace read=public
When
 ## These facts come from the admitted invocation, not operation input fields.
 scenario capture() -> text by=members
  do
   create Trace {who=actor.id,scope=team.id,zone=team.timezone,origin=operation.source,invocation=operation.id,instant=now} as trace
   require trace.instant==trace.created
   return trace.invocation
 scenario identify() -> text by=authenticated
  do return actor.id
 scenario anonymous() -> bool by=public
  do return actor==null
 scenario source() -> text by=public
  do return operation.source
 scenario clock() -> datetime by=public
  do return now
Then
